# [TFQ-1155] Per-class minimum weights 3, 4, 7 and distance 3 on the 3x4 torus

## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

On the 3x4 tetron torus (12 sites, 24 channels, 12 islands) exhaustive Gray-code coset search gives Phi1 = 3 for the column class, 4 for the row class and 7 for their sum, all ClosedResidual, so the distance of that instance is 3.

### Governing Obligation
Fixed instance only; additivity and d = min(rows, cols) for other sizes are MAJ-CLAIM-DISTANCE-FAMILY.

### Witness Audit
Lean toric_distance_3x4 is rfl of min 3 4 = 3 and torus_3x4_additive_weight is rfl of 3 + 4 = 7. The Python test runs the exact coset search (2^11 cosets, under budget) and asserts exact = True with weights 3, 4, 7; the three classes are the nonzero elements of the 2-dimensional H1, so their minimum is the distance. Rust checks only representative weights 3 and 4.
